pages.text: A bright yellow protective suit. Each piece keeps out $(l)25%$() of the $(l:nuclear/radiation)radiation$(/l); the $(l)full suit$() keeps out all of it. It gives little armor against everything else, and it also keeps the cold of $(l:nuclear/coolant_mixer)coolant pools$(/l) out.

pages.title: Geiger Counter
pages.text: Hold it in either hand: it $(l)clicks$() faster the more radiation there is, and shows the level in $(l)Rad$() above the hotbar, green when safe, orange from 20 Rad (sickness), red from 100 Rad. A Muffler never silences it.
